findings.counterevidence: 官方同样写行动失败，项目继承；普通攻击和移动并不因此随机失败。

evidence.fact: Venomous Breath施加EFF_CRIPPLING_POISON；physical.lua:300-325仅增加talent_fail_chance，失败判定只影响使用技能。
activate设置talent_fail_chance，而非普通攻击或移动失败。

findings.official_target:

findings.source:
You breathe crippling poison in a frontal cone of radius %d. Any target caught in the area will take %0.2f nature damage each turn for 6 turns.
		The poison also gives enemies a %d%% chance to fail actions more complicated than basic attacks and movement, while it is in effect.
		The damage will increase with your Strength, and the critical chance is based on your Mental crit rate.
		Each point in Venomous Breath also increases your nature resistance by 3%%, and your nature damage by 4%%.
findings.topic: 剧毒吐息遗漏普通攻击和移动例外

findings.counterevidence: 两个占位符均为%d，类型校验不能检出语义颠倒；官方半径在前、范围在后与实际参数顺序一致。

evidence.fact: 源码tformat依次传入radius和range，radius=1、range=5；当前无args_order重排表，项目先写射程再写半径，运行时呈现射程1、半径5。

findings.official_target: 加速半径 %d 范围内的所有燃烧效果，范围 %d, 立刻造成 125%% 剩余燃烧伤害。
findings.project_target: 加速射程 %d 内半径 %d 球体中所有生物身上的燃烧效果，消耗它们，立即造成剩余燃烧伤害的125%%。
findings.recommendation: 恢复半径在前射程在后的顺序，或为该键明确配置参数重排。
findings.source: accelerate burning effects on all creatures in a radius %d ball within range %d, consuming them to instantly inflict 125%% of all remaining burn damage
findings.topic: 燃烧加速装备的半径与射程实参颠倒

findings.counterevidence: 官方基于魔法和敏捷的问题被项目继承，并非泛指魔法类别。

evidence.fact: 伤害计算使用who:getMag()/2和who:getDex()/3，指魔力与敏捷属性；Magic属性冻结译名为魔力。

findings.official_target: 攻击距离 %d 内的敌人，造成 100%% 闪电武器伤害并在半径 %d 内释放电弧，造成 %0.2f 到 %0.2f 点闪电伤害 (基于魔法和敏捷)
findings.project_target: 攻击距离 %d 内的敌人，造成 100%% 闪电武器伤害并在半径 %d 内释放电弧，造成 %0.2f 到 %0.2f 点闪电伤害（基于魔法和敏捷）

findings.counterevidence: 英文Preemptively reacts表达反应机制；官方和项目均未明确受击触发，容易读作常驻抗性。共振与共鸣的用词差异仅建议，不据此扩大机制结论。

evidence.fact: callbackOnTakeDamageBeforeResists在受到所列类型伤害且dam>0、src非自身、没有现存CHROMATIC_RESISTANCE时给予5回合相应抗性。

findings.official_target: 对 %s 伤害共振，增加 %d 相应抗性 5 回合。
findings.project_target: 对 %s 伤害共振，相应抗性提高 %d，持续 5 回合。
findings.recommendation: 明确受到所列类型伤害时先行获得对应抗性，持续5回合。
findings.source: Preemptively reacts to %s damage, increasing the appropriate resistance by %d for 5 turns.
findings.topic: 多彩共鸣遗漏受到伤害时才触发的条件

findings.counterevidence: 英文和官方同样写增加所有受到的伤害，项目忠实继承表面含义，但与固定源码不同。原抗性50降低20点后伤害由50变70，实际增幅40%，不能说固定增加20%。

evidence.fact: activate以resists.all=-eff.power降低全部伤害抗性；并非设置固定比例承伤增加。
最终伤害乘以(100-res)/100，降低抗性与固定比例增伤不同。

findings.counterevidence: 仅短提示措辞，完整说明和受害者语境可消歧；不能仅凭这四字判为机制翻译错误。官方原有相同措辞。

evidence.fact: PUNCTURED_ARMOUR为受害者的负面效果；同族日志已写护甲被刺穿，浮动提示仍写护甲贯通。

		你有几率使用致盲之沙、缴械酸雾、冻结之息、眩晕闪电或震慑之焰攻击敌人，造成 %d%% 点对应伤害类型的武器伤害。

Unleash raw, chaotic elemental damage upon your enemy.
		You strike your enemy for %d%% weapon damage in one of blinding sand, disarming acid, freezing and slowing ice, dazing lightning or stunning flames, with equal odds.

findings.source:
Your mucus is brought to near sentience.
		Each turn, there is a %d%% chance that a random spot of your mucus will spawn a Mucus Ooze.
		Mucus Oozes last %d turns and will attack any of your foes by spitting slime at them.
		You may have up to %d Mucus Oozes active at any time (based on your Cunning).
		Any time you deal a mental critical, the remaining time on all of your Mucus Oozes will increase by 2.
		The spawn chance increases with your Mindpower.
